headline: Garmin’s new Fenix 9 adds brighter screens and smoother map panning
summary: Garmin launched its new Fenix 9 rugged smartwatches with an OLED display. The screen boasts up to 3,000 nits brightness, doubling its predecessor. Starting at $999.99, the Fenix 9 also features 50% more RAM.

headline: Trump is upping the price of Big Tech’s favorite visa
summary: The Department of Homeland Security announced a fee of over $103,000 for H-1B visas. The State Department plans to revoke up to 200,000 asylum seeker visas. These changes significantly impact legal immigration and tech industry workforce.

headline: At just $8, you owe it to yourself to grab Inscryption
summary: The bizarre deckbuilder 'Inscryption' by Daniel Mullins is currently on sale for $8. This Steam version deal is available via Humble. It's a fantastic opportunity to experience the developer's unique games.

headline: The Witcher 3 is getting a remaster
summary: CD Projekt Red is remastering the hit RPG 'The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt'. The updated game will launch on September 29th with improved visuals and combat. It also includes a reimagined skill tree and the first two expansions.

headline: Toxic: A Fairy Tale for Grown-Ups Review
summary: The review for 'Toxic: A Fairy Tale for Grown-Ups' describes it as a sloppy gangster epic. Indian megastar Yash delivers a bloodthirsty performance. The film explores themes of violence and vengeance.

headline: Showa American Story: The First Hands-On Preview
summary: 'Showa American Story' creates an unforgettable, eccentric B-movie world. Its deliberate 'jank' and niche style mean polish lags behind AAA titles. Despite combat shortcomings, it's shaping up to be a unique, fascinating ride.

headline: The Baseus 25,000mAh 140W Laptop Power Bank With Dual USB-C Cables Drops to Just $45.29
summary: The Baseus 25,000mAh 140W Laptop Power Bank is now available for just $45.29. This powerful charger includes dual USB-C cables. The discount is accessible to all, without requiring an Amazon Prime membership.

headline: The Dog Stars Review
summary: Ridley Scott's 'The Dog Stars' is a post-apocalyptic survivor drama. The film is criticized for its emotionally reserved portrayal of grief. It reportedly keeps its feelings 'in a triple layer of emotional bubble wrap'.

headline: Dolly Parton: The life of an iconic country singer
summary: Iconic country musician Dolly Parton has passed away at the age of 80. Her death was announced by her team on social media. The world mourns the loss of the beloved singer's legendary career.

headline: Winter energy prices expected to rise to three-year high
summary: Winter energy prices are predicted to reach a three-year high. Millions of households will be impacted by an increase in Ofgem's energy price cap. This rise will significantly affect household budgets nationwide.

headline: CIA chief travels to Moscow for unannounced talks, US media reports
summary: US media reports indicate the CIA chief traveled to Moscow for unannounced discussions. Flight tracking data confirms an American military aircraft journeyed to Russia via Latvia. The purpose of these high-level talks remains undisclosed.

headline: Why Pride is facing a backlash - from inside and outside the LGBT community
summary: Pride events are encountering increasing backlash from both within and outside the LGBT community. Companies that once fully supported Pride now show hesitation. The article explores the evolving dynamics of support and criticism for the movement.
